description:
Items site-split-23 and site-split-30 are done, but the parent-chain recovery path was never exercised: rehearsal covered rollback, forward and wrong-digest only. Nine consecutive production deploys have failed since 2026-10-12 12:08Z (the first on the Explorer contract mismatch, the other eight on the parity gate because the bundle's parent was never deployed). Producer parents chain by "last built", not "last deployed", so one undeployable bundle breaks every later automatic bundle until a manual recovery.

Rehearse the recovery on the rehearsal target, then recover production. Also decide and record whether the parent should be the last deployed generation (read from the site receipt) rather than the last built bundle, or that manual recovery is the intended mechanism.
